column3: N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine: DMT C12H16N2 + CH2 (PubChem resolves "MET" to methionine)

3-methylmethamphetamine (meaning confirmed by the project owner): methamphetamine C10H15N + CH2. PubChem resolves the name to 3-methoxy-4-methylamphetamine (C11H17NO), a different compound
